title: A frame: one moment of the site, for UAT (draft 0.1.0)
description: frames/<id>/frame.json in the rehearsal outbox (einkk-outbox-dev) only, next to the documents the engine computed for that moment (frames/<id>/season.json, predictions/..., history.json, finals/...). In rehearsal mode the page opened with ?frame=<id> reads those documents and freezes its display clock at `at`. Production never reads it.

id.description: The frame's name, as in its folder and the ?frame= link.

at.description: The moment the documents were computed for, and the time the page shows as now.

label.description: What the frame shows, for whoever opens it.
